integrity: Exact normalization, complete domain, analytical proof, reproducible finite diagnostics. No independent validation or publication-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary ensemble-state purity for homogeneous infinite nearest-neighbor Z^d walks, complete state-independent Poisson resets to the origin, fixed integer d and fixed kappa in asymptotic limits. No claim about finite tori in a simultaneous r->0 limit, arbitrary graphs, non-Poisson clocks, or subsystem entanglement entropy. Stronger unindexed classical Laplace asymptotic theorems could imply the analytic mechanism.
title: Dimension-indexed logarithmic purity singularities for Poisson-reset quantum lattice walks
